scope: Read-only review of exact permission fix and activate-resume branch. Script was not executed; no host/provider/DB/browser calls, tests, private configuration contents, or provider credentials were accessed.

root_release_modes.detail: prepare explicitly chmods the three newly-created release directory levels to 0755 despite umask 0077. Resume checks each with lstat as a real root-owned directory without group/world write before changing only that directory's mode to 0755. It rejects symlink/non-directory/foreign-owner cases before chmod.

resume_admission.detail: The new activate-resume phase requires the original activate receipt to be FAILED with the expected CalledProcessError and exact recovery marker; source/prepared receipt and full package hashes remain pinned; baseline snapshot must still match; current must be the expected symlink to the exact release; the service account UID/GID/home/shell and sole group are exact; state contains only the expected incoming document with exact reviewed digest; all three owned unit files match the package and report inactive; and the public include is absent. It creates a separate resume receipt and does not overwrite the failed receipt.

resume_mutation_boundary.detail: Before continuing the previously reviewed import/accept/status/Nginx path, resume changes only the three checked release-directory modes and then runs Node syntax check under the service UID. The existing-component baseline and Nginx guards are still checked before activation steps. Recovery retains owned release/state/history and only detaches the exact include, removes only exact resolving enable links, and queues stops/reload.

minor_readback_nit.detail: The partial incoming document guard uses filehash(owner), which follows symlinks and does not itself verify regular-file type/owner/mode. The later launcher import uses the package's bounded O_NOFOLLOW read path, so a substituted symlink fails closed before accepting the source; the digest also binds the actual bytes. An explicit lstat regular-file and expected UID/mode guard would make the resume precondition more precise and avoid a predictable late failure.

retained_caveats: Resume is tied to the exact prior CalledProcessError/recovery receipt and fixed UID/GID; any drift should stop and require fresh readback rather than widening the recovery path.
Activation PASS remains install/routing status, not successful automatic source retrieval. Owner-supplied reviewed documentation does not establish TLS freshness or account identity.
deployment_gate: No blocking issue found in the reviewed resume delta. The symlink/file metadata nit is fail-closed because subsequent O_NOFOLLOW import rejects it; optionally add the lstat guard before execution. Do not run resume without independently reading the expected prior failure receipt and exact partial-state evidence.
